message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: Defendant set fire to house of three brothers, causing property damage, but no serious consequences? The prosecution says "故意放火焚烧他人财物，危害公共安全，尚未造成严重后果". Under Chinese Criminal Law, the crime is "故意毁坏财物罪" (intentional destruction of property) or "放火罪" (arson). Actually Chinese law: Article 114 (放火罪) - "故意放火，危害公共安全的" is arson. If only property of others, also "故意毁坏财物罪" (Article 275). But arson is more specific when fire endangers public safety. The facts: He set fire to a house, causing fire to spread, but no serious consequences. The prosecution says "故意放火焚烧他人财物，危害公共安全，尚未造成严重后果". So the crime is "放火罪". Also possibly "危害公共安全罪"? Actually "放火罪" is under "危害公共安全罪" category. So likely only one crime: "放火罪". Could also be "故意毁坏财物罪"? But the law: If fire endangers public safety, it's arson. If only property, it's destruction. Since they mention "危害公共安全", arson. So answer: [罪名]放火罪<eoa>
